pll2d8c2-d1e3514.summary: States that God undoubtedly appeared to humans in bodily forms, as Augustine shows in De Trinitate II from scriptural texts, sometimes speaking in God's person without distinction of persons, sometimes with distinction.

pl-l2d8c2.summary: States that God undoubtedly appeared to humans in bodily forms, as Augustine shows in De Trinitate II from various scriptural texts, sometimes speaking in the person of God without distinction of persons, sometimes with distinction.
claims: God appeared to humans in bodily forms.
Sometimes God spoke without distinction of persons, sometimes with distinction.
